headline: Executive order aims to link federally funded research and development to manufacturing and jobs inside the United States.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs how federal agencies handle research and development they fund so that it supports manufacturing in the United States and American jobs. No official summary was provided, so the specific rules, requirements, and agency duties it creates cannot be described here.

who_it_affects.group: Universities, companies, and labs that receive federal research funding
who_it_affects.how: The order likely shapes how results of their federally funded research are expected to support manufacturing in the United States.
The order directs how these agencies manage their research programs with domestic manufacturing in mind.

who_it_affects.group: Manufacturers and manufacturing workers in the United States
who_it_affects.how: The order is meant to support domestic manufacturing and the jobs tied to it, though the exact effects are not stated in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed July 28, 2023; executive orders usually take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
